tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub 'khor 'das bcud len bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ 'dir gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub mdun bskyed la brten pa ni/ kyai rdor sogs bla med yi dam gang rung gi gzhi bsnyen nam brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen pa song bas dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan nas 'bras sogs bkram khar bdud rtsi ril bu sogs gtor rdzas sku bag can bsres pa'i zlum gtor pad+ma'i snying po pad+ma 'dab bzhis bskor zhing / mar rgyan ci mdzes dmar rgyan/ mda' dar dkar po btsugs pa mañdzi sogs kyi khar bzhag drung zlum gtor de mtshungs chung ba bzhi bzhag gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su tshe ril/ bum rdzas so lnga/ shug 'bru/ ba lu dkar po'i me tog lug mtshe/ mkhan dkar te rtsi bzhi/ brag zhun/ lcags zhun/ cong zhi dmar po/ bur dkar/ grog mo sbrang mar song ba'i sbrang rtsi/ dbyar gung 'bri mar te/ dwangs ma lnga rnams kyang zhib btags btab pa/ g.yon du ka li tshe chang / mdun du chu gnyis nyer mchod/ thun gsum mam bzhir gso ru'i mtheb skyu zhal zas/ rang mdun rdor dril nang mchod sogs bshams la/ yar tshes bzang ba nas mtshams la zhugs te/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ so so'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rdor 'dzin/ dril gsil/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs gsum/ brag rdzong ma'i bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas khro bcu rang la thim gyi bar byas la/

mdun gyi tshe gtor/ tshe ril/ tshe chang gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'od sngon po nam mkha' ltar dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa dges shing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ sma ra dang smin ma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas byang sems tshe'i lha tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de'i thugs kar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang hūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rang dang sbyin bdag gi bla tshe yar ba 'thor ba nyams pa thams cad bkug nas hūm̐ la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs rje nus pa mthu stobs rnams dang /

snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dpag tu med pa chil li li byung nas mgon po'i sku'i nang thams cad mer gyis khengs te ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun sprin las char pa babs pa ltar babs/ rang dang sbyin bdag gi rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa gnas kyi nang dang / lus kyi cha shas thams cad khyab cing khengs pas skad cig de nyid la nad gdon sdig sgrib khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa nyi zla'i 'od zer shar bas mun pa rang sangs su song ba ltar byang zhing dag lus sems thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes su gnas gyur par bsam pa'i dmigs pa yang yang gsal btab cing / ngag tu/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma ma ā yang na dā na pa ti/ yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ thun sdud pa na/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon pos bdag dang sbyin bdag gi tshe'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams ye shes sogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtor ma chung ba de/ kyai rdor gtor bsngo ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ bā l+yā de swāhā/ gsum sogs kyis bsngo/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil gyis/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/

/mgon po gri thod gaṇ+ḍe can/ /rab dkar pad nyi ro gdan bzhugs/ /tshe stsol gur gyi mgon por bstod/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon sdug bsngal sogs/ /tshe yi bar chad kun srungs shig /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes sogs/ /ma lus 'phel zhing rgyas gyur nas/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ci bsam kun/ /yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gur gyi mgon po zhu ba las byung ba'i tshe rdzas su gyur/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrung / sngon dus 'khor bar lan mang 'khor ba'i tshe/ /gzhan srog bcad dang 'tsho ba 'phrog pa sogs/ /tshe thung gyur pa'i las sgrib ci bsags pa/ /de kun byang zhing dag pa'i rgyur gyur cig /chos mthun 'byor pas tshe ring gnas pa dang / /byang chub sems mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /rtse gcig zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom pa la/ /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen rgyas par shog /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs/ /sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan/ /ja chang zhal dro rgyun mi chad/ /skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog/ //ces gur mgon dkar por mdun bskyed tshe ril tshe chang yod pa'i gzhung ma mthong yang 'gal ba cher mi 'dug pas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bsam yas sman gong chos dgon zur 'chad kun dga' chos 'phel zhes bya bas bskul ba bzhin sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal nag po chen po gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
